variant.name: stock_load
variant.description: previous stock-load design (reference only): stock load, RES 35 %, taps [0.85, 1.15]

scenario.name: stock_load
scenario.description: previous design kept for reference: stock load, RES = 35 % of the load, PV set points scaled by one factor (slack keeps its base output), taps within [0.85, 1.15]

dispatch.rule_text: all in-service synchronous PV p0 multiplied by (sum p0 - P_RES)/sum p0 so the renewable in-feed displaces synchronous generation and the slack keeps (approximately) its base output

placement.rule: candidates: in-service buses with Vn >= 200 kV, no static or synchronous generator, in the slack's island, short-circuit ratio S_sc/P_max >= 3 (S_sc: reactance network, machines through x''d; P_max = largest block). Strong set S: S_sc >= median over candidates. Hubs: strongest bus of S, then farthest-point (max-min effective reactance) sampling within S. Members: clusters take turns adding the nearest unassigned bus to their hub, first from S then from all candidates, skipping buses within 0.005 pu effective reactance of a placed plant (one plant per substation). Ties by bus order.

generator_trip_rule: largest in-service synchronous machines by MVA rating (ties: |P|, idx) not linked to the slack; trip sets u=0 on the machine and every linked exciter/governor/PSS
load_disconnection_rule: largest |q0| in-service PQ loads (n_blocks/2), signed; q<0 loads flagged

redispatch.pairing_rule: down units in exporting, up units in importing (pseudo-)areas, ranked by P; a pair is used only if the down unit stays above max(must-run, governor VMIN) and the up unit below min(governor VMAX, capability) after the 20 % exchange
